classFeature.name: Action Surge
entries: Once on your turn, you can take one additional action.

classFeature.name: Fighting Style
entries: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. {@feat Defense|XPHB} is recommended.

classFeature.name: Second Wind
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can regain Hit Points equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Fighter level.

classFeature.name: Weapon Mastery
entries: You can use the mastery properties of three kinds of weapons.

classFeature.name: Action Surge
entries: On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

classFeature.name: Tactical Mind
entries: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to add {@dice 1d10} to the roll.

classFeature.name: Fighter Subclass
entries: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another feat of your choice.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another feat of your choice.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another feat of your choice.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Fighter subclass.

subclassFeature.name: Champion
entries: A Champion focuses on the development of martial prowess.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Critical
entries: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

subclassFeature.name: Remarkable Athlete
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.

subclassFeature.name: Additional Fighting Style
entries: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.
